name: Senvio for WooCommerce
author: senvio

sections.description:
Senvio for WooCommerce is the gateway to the full power of the Senvio.ai ecosystem — an AI-driven optimization platform built to help online stores grow efficiently using accurate, privacy-compliant data.

The plugin itself is intentionally lightweight and focused solely on secure tracking and data synchronization.
Senvio.ai handles all advanced logic, including AI recommendations, Google Ads optimization, reporting, customer insights and predictive analysis.

🔒 Privacy-first and fully GDPR compliant

Senvio.ai follows strict data protection standards:
– processing only essential, anonymized event data
– not storing sensitive information in WordPress
– using encrypted communication
– ensuring all analytics and tracking methods meet RODO/GDPR requirements
– providing full transparency and data minimization

This ensures your store stays compliant while still benefiting from powerful analytics and AI-driven tools.

🚀 Accurate, resilient tracking that unlocks better optimization

The plugin captures essential WooCommerce events with first-party tracking technology, ensuring that every important interaction is recorded:

  • product views
  • cart and checkout steps
  • purchases and revenue
  • behavioral patterns
  • customer lifecycle events

This data powers Senvio.ai’s advanced analytics and insights.

🤖 AI-powered recommendations, insights and automation

Inside the Senvio.ai dashboard, you gain access to a full suite of tools such as:

  • personalized recommendation models
  • optimization suggestions
  • predictive analytics
  • segmentation
  • anomaly detection
  • automated reports

🎯 Smarter Google Ads performance and budget allocation

Senvio.ai evaluates your product, customer and ad data to generate:

  • campaign and bid optimization insights
  • wasted-spend detection
  • keyword and audience suggestions
  • ROAS predictions
  • device and product-level performance patterns

💡 More than a tracker — a complete eCommerce intelligence layer

The plugin provides the data.
Senvio.ai transforms it into actionable insights.

⚡ Fast setup — no coding needed

All you need is your API Token. The plugin then:

  • syncs products and orders
  • tracks events instantly
  • ensures GDPR-compliant data flow
  • enhances signals for AI recommendations and insights

Configuration

  1. Navigate to WP Admin → Senvio
  2. Enter your API Token from your Senvio.ai dashboard
  3. Click “Verify and Save”

External services

This plugin connects to Senvio.ai, an external analytics and optimization service. This connection is required for the plugin to function.

What the service is and what it is used for:
Senvio.ai is used to collect and process analytics and ecommerce-related events in order to provide reports, insights, and optimization features within the plugin.

What data is sent and when:
The plugin sends analytics and ecommerce event data to Senvio.ai, including store and product identifiers, event information (such as page views, product interactions, and purchases), and technical data necessary to perform analytics and API communication.

Data is sent when:
– Visitors interact with the store (frontend tracking)
– WooCommerce events occur (such as orders or product updates)
– The plugin communicates with the Senvio.ai API for validation and synchronization

Service provider information:
Service provider:
Senvio.ai

Terms of Service: https://senvio.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Senvio_regulamin_PL.pdf
Privacy Policy: https://senvio.ai/polityka-prywatnosci-2/

Verification

  • A success message appears if your API Token is valid
  • An error message appears if the token is invalid or expired
  • No further configuration is needed — tracking begins immediately
  • Visit your Senvio.ai dashboard to confirm products, events and orders are synchronizing correctly
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Search for “Senvio for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Alternatively:
– Download the plugin ZIP file
– Upload it via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
– Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Do I need a Senvio.ai account?

Yes. The plugin requires an active Senvio.ai account and a valid API Token.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. Senvio for WooCommerce is fully RODO/GDPR compliant.
The plugin does not store sensitive personal data and only transmits essential events using encrypted, privacy-first mechanisms. All processing and analytics occur on secure Senvio.ai servers following strict data protection rules.

Does this plugin slow down my store?

No. It is extremely lightweight. All processing and AI logic take place on Senvio.ai servers.

What events are tracked?

Views, add-to-cart interactions, checkout steps, purchases and behavioral signals required for analytics and recommendations.

Can I configure recommendations or Google Ads features inside WordPress?

No. All advanced features are managed exclusively in the Senvio.ai dashboard.

How do I disconnect the integration?

Remove or reset your API Token in WP Admin → Senvio.

  • Added proper input sanitization for $_SERVER variables

1.0.2

  • Fixed script enqueueing to use WordPress wp_enqueue_script functions
  • Added external service documentation to readme.txt
  • Improved code compliance with WordPress plugin guidelines

1.0.1

  • Bug fixes and improvements
  • Enhanced security with capability checks
  • Improved error handling

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • WooCommerce event tracking
